cpp-01-c1.text: Bjarne Stroustrup. Bjarne Stroustrup's FAQ. stroustrup.com.
cpp-01-c1.quote: I started work on what became C++ in 1979. The initial version was called "C with Classes".
cpp-01-c1.claim: In 1979 Bjarne Stroustrup started building C++, which began as "C with Classes" and added object-oriented programming to C while preserving its low-level control.

cpp-01-c3.text: Bjarne Stroustrup and Herb Sutter (eds.), Standard C++ Foundation. C++ Core Guidelines, E.6: Use RAII to prevent leaks. isocpp.github.io.
cpp-01-c3.quote: Leaks are typically unacceptable. Manual resource release is error-prone.
cpp-01-c3.claim: With manual cleanup(); calls, an exception between acquire and cleanup leaks the resource.
